SELECT A.NO AS no, TYPE AS type, A.NAME AS name, A.USER_ID AS userId, A.DEPTCD AS deptCd, A.DEPTNM AS deptNm, DATE_FORMAT( EXPIRATION_DT, '%Y-%m-%d') AS edate, A.ATTACHED_YN AS attachedYn, A.SEARCH_YN AS searchYn, DATE_FORMAT( CREATE_DT, '%Y-%m-%d') AS createDt, A.CREATE_ID AS createId, A.CREATE_NAME AS createNm, A.PURPOSE AS purpose, A.FILE_PATH AS filePath, A.ALARM_YN AS alarmYn, A.REGISTRANT_YN AS registrantYn, A.ALARM_MAIL_YN AS alarmMailYn, A.ALARM_SMS_YN AS alarmSmsYn, A.ALARM_MONITOR_YN AS alarmMonitorYn, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT B.IP ORDER BY B.IP SEPARATOR ',') AS userIp, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT
CAST(if(C.USER_EMAIL is null, null, xcndec(#{encryptAlgorithm}, #{encryptSize}, #{encryptKey}, C.USER_EMAIL)) AS CHAR)
C.USER_EMAIL
ORDER BY C.USER_EMAIL SEPARATOR ',') AS userEmail FROM UI_CONSENT A LEFT OUTER JOIN UI_CONSENT_IP B ON A.NO = B.NO LEFT OUTER JOIN UI_USER_EMAIL C ON A.USER_ID = C.USER_ID WHERE 1=1 AND DATE_FORMAT( EXPIRATION_DT, '%Y%m%d' ) >= DATE_FORMAT( SYSDATE(), '%Y%m%d' )
AND TYPE = #{type}
AND NAME LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchStr}, '%')
AND APPCD = 'A' GROUP BY A.NO, TYPE, NAME, A.USER_ID, DEPTCD, DEPTNM, DATE_FORMAT(EXPIRATION_DT, '%Y-%m-%d' ), ATTACHED_YN, SEARCH_YN, DATE_FORMAT(CREATE_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %T' ), CREATE_ID, CREATE_NAME, PURPOSE, FILE_PATH, APPCD, FILE_NAME, ALARM_YN, REGISTRANT_YN, ALARM_MAIL_YN, ALARM_SMS_YN, ALARM_MONITOR_YN ORDER BY A.NO DESC

SELECT SUM(CNT) AS CNT FROM ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS CNT FROM UI_BUSI_IPRANGE WHERE INET6_ATON( #{startIp} ) BETWEEN INET6_ATON(START_IP) AND INET6_ATON(END_IP) UNION ALL SELECT COUNT(*) AS CNT FROM UI_BUSI_IPRANGE WHERE INET6_ATON( #{endIp} ) BETWEEN INET6_ATON(START_IP) AND INET6_ATON(END_IP) UNION ALL SELECT COUNT(*) AS CNT FROM UI_BUSI_IPRANGE WHERE INET6_ATON(START_IP) BETWEEN INET6_ATON( #{startIp} ) AND INET6_ATON( #{endIp} ) UNION ALL SELECT COUNT(*) AS CNT FROM UI_BUSI_IPRANGE WHERE INET6_ATON(END_IP) BETWEEN INET6_ATON( #{startIp} ) AND INET6_ATON( #{endIp} ) ) AS RS
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO UI_CONSENT (NO, TYPE, NAME, USER_ID, DEPTNM, EXPIRATION_DT, ATTACHED_YN, CREATE_DT, CREATE_ID, CREATE_NAME, PURPOSE, FILE_PATH, APPCD, FILE_NAME, ALARM_YN, REGISTRANT_YN, ALARM_MAIL_YN, ALARM_SMS_YN, ALARM_MONITOR_YN) VALUES (#{no}, #{type}, #{name}, #{userId}, #{deptNm}, DATE_FORMAT(#{edate},'%Y%m%d'), #{attachedYn}, now(), #{createId}, #{createNm}, #{purpose}, #{filePath}, '', #{fileName}, #{alarmYn,}, #{registrantYn}, #{alarmMailYn}, #{alarmSmsYn}, #{alarmMonitorYn})
mapper.update: UPDATE UI_CONSENT SET TYPE = #{type}, NAME = #{name}, USER_ID = #{userId}, DEPTNM = #{deptNm}, EXPIRATION_DT = DATE_FORMAT(#{edate},'%Y%m%d'), ATTACHED_YN = #{attachedYn}, CREATE_ID = #{createId}, CREATE_NAME = #{createNm}, PURPOSE = #{purpose}, FILE_PATH = #{filePath}, FILE_NAME = #{fileName}, ALARM_YN =#{alarmYn}, REGISTRANT_YN = #{registrantYn}, ALARM_MAIL_YN = #{alarmMailYn}, ALARM_SMS_YN = #{alarmSmsYn}, ALARM_MONITOR_YN = #{alarmMonitorYn} WHERE NO = #{no}
mapper.select: SELECT CONCAT( DATE_FORMAT(SYSDATE(),'%Y%m%d'), '_', LPAD( IFNULL(MAX(NO),0)+1, 7, 0) ) AS newSeq, DATE_FORMAT(SYSDATE(),'%Y%m%d') AS currentDt, IFNULL( MAX(NO), 0)+1 AS no FROM UI_CONSENT_SEQ WHERE DATE_FORMAT(CURRENT_DT,'%Y%m%d') = DATE_FORMAT(SYSDATE(),'%Y%m%d')
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM UI_CONSENT_SEQ WHERE NO = #{no} AND DATE_FORMAT(CURRENT_DT,'%Y%m%d') = DATE_FORMAT(#{date},'%Y%m%d')
